turnos.t: Dry deposition, when winds slow down by friction and particles settle. And wet deposition, when rain washes the dust out of the air. It matters because heavy rain leaches nutrients out of Amazon soils, so the phosphorus in Saharan dust is a significant input.
It depends on the boundary. If the system is the Amazon, it's an input. If the system is the whole Earth, it's a transfer between two storages. Always say which boundary you're using.
